independence.original_contract_treatment: Only exact-head source-card-v2.json and contract-v2.md were inspected from PR195. They are untrusted scope proposals, not evidence that any theorem or proof is implemented or correct.

printed_contract.objects: Rounds t=1,...,T; target y_t in [0,1], prediction x_t in [0,1], then target revealed and loss (x_t-y_t)^2. In the IID discussion the targets have one fixed law on [0,1] chosen before play.
printed_contract.feedback: Prediction is chosen before the current target is revealed; previous observations can inform a strategy. The displayed x_t notation does not imply a deterministic constant or independence by itself.
printed_contract.oracle: If the distribution were known, predicting its mean every round has expected cumulative loss T sigma^2. This is an oracle benchmark, not an unknown-law algorithm.
printed_contract.optimality: The author asserts that one cannot do better, and later that cumulative and average expected excess are nonnegative. No proof of this adaptive lower bound is printed here.
printed_contract.quantifier_order: One distribution is fixed before play. A fixed comparator u is a scalar held constant across rounds and sample outcomes; the minimum is outside expectation. Learner predictions may depend on strict-past observations. Positive finite T underlies the average formula.
printed_contract.success_criterion: Cumulative excess grows sublinearly, equivalently average excess tends to zero as T tends to infinity. This is a criterion, not a proved achievement or rate.
printed_contract.randomization_scope: No seed, tape, sigma field, filtration, randomization kernel, conditioning formula or expectation over private randomization is defined on these pages. The explicit expectation subscript lists target variables. A private-tape expectation requires a declared derived extension.
contextual_boundaries: The arbitrary-sequence pathwise regret on page2 is distinct from minimum expected fixed loss.
The deterministic qualifier belongs to the removal-of-expectation transition, not a formal randomized IID model.
Pathwise regret may be signed; the printed nonnegativity assertion refers to the IID expected quantities.
Generic no-regret uses an ordinary limit for each fixed comparator, not a printed limsup, uniform-comparator theorem or convergence proof.
Footnote1 permits a larger action set W in some settings; it is not extra side information or an IID randomization theorem.

proposed_derived_contract.authority: Interpretation of the exact-head source contract only. No Lean headers were read; exact signature equivalence remains for separate semantic review.
proposed_derived_contract.ambient_model: A probability space carrying measurable real target coordinates (Y_t) that are jointly independent, identically distributed, and almost surely in [0,1]. A measurable private tape S takes values in an arbitrary measurable space and is independent of the WHOLE target-process random element with its product sigma field.
proposed_derived_contract.information: Use G_t = sigma(S, Y_s for s<t). Each prediction A_t is real and F_t-measurable for a sigma field F_t subordinate to G_t. The F_t family need not be monotone. G_t is monotone. No current/future target information or arbitrary side information is admitted.
proposed_derived_contract.concrete_policy: At zero-based t, A_t = pi_t(S,(Y_0,...,Y_{t-1})); pi_t is jointly measurable on tape times finite history. For every seed and every history in [0,1]^t its output lies in [0,1]. Only actual histories must be legal almost surely.
proposed_derived_contract.derived_expected_endpoint: For finite T, with m=E[Y_0], E[sum_{t<T}(A_t-Y_t)^2] - min_{u in [0,1]} E[sum_{t<T}(u-Y_t)^2] = sum_{t<T} E[(A_t-m)^2] >= 0.
proposed_derived_contract.endpoint_provenance: The displayed identity here makes explicit the contract phrase exact cumulative literal expected-fixed excess identity. It is a proposed derived mathematical target, not a formula printed on pages1-2, and not a claim that an implementation has this exact signature.
proposed_derived_contract.expectation: Expectation is over the joint tape/target probability law. No per-tape lower bound, pathwise nonnegative regret, or interchange of expectation and hindsight minimum follows.
proposed_derived_contract.time: Source t=1,...,T maps to derived t=0,...,T-1. At t=0 the strict history is empty, but the first prediction may depend on S. T=0 finite identity is an empty-sum extension; it does not define the source average at zero.
exclusions: No completed sigma fields or general AE-measurable factorization.
No high-probability, pathwise or almost-sure regret guarantee.
No asymptotic success, no rate, and no successful unknown-law learner.
No implementation/proof acceptance or chapter completion.

assumption_delta_ledger.detail: Printed standing model; explicit joint independence must retain its full meaning.
Printed move order; formal causal information relation is not printed.
Measurability/integrability are required to interpret the expectation statements; must be derived where available, not inserted as proof conclusions.
Contract extension; whole-process independence is explicit. It is not a literal printed premise.
One precise class of causal randomized predictions, not a universal representation theorem.
Formal probability-law interpretation and off-history generality; all required moments and actual feasibility remain obligations.
Derived identity strengthening the printed lower benchmark, absent from printed proof.
Finite identity/nonnegativity does not discharge success or normalization/convergence obligations.
